subject: Mid-cycle constraint prioritization & launch ramp plan
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Lee <emma@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mid-cycle constraint prioritization & launch ramp plan

Team —

Quick mid-cycle pulse ahead of next week's QBR rehearsal. I reviewed the Q3 OKR snapshot and dependency matrix (attached) and want to align on one coordinated approach to limit scope creep and protect our launch runway. High-level status: 

- OKR: Dedicated runtime availability (SLO: 95% p90 latency) — currently AT RISK (infra queue + perf work).
- OKR: Customer ramp (2 enterprise pilots) — ON TRACK but requires capacity reservation.
- OKR: Cost-per-token improvement — PARTIAL (blocked by some quantization infra effort).

Primary asks:
1) Prioritize the minimal set of infra changes required to hit the Dedicated runtime SLO for initial pilots. If we defer non-critical perf work, how many sprint-weeks can we free up? (Karthik)
2) Vanessa — can we reallocate 1 PM + 1 SWE from the growth backlog to support pilot onboarding for two months? If not, propose an alternative.
3) Laura — QBR needs a 1-slide executive summary and a 1-page risk register by Monday EOD. Can you own the asset and nominate the presenter?
4) Ops partner check — I CC'ed Emma from Acme Health to confirm expected pilot go-live windows (she's fine with a soft start, no hard SLA yet). Ops vendor (CloudPartner) may need a short burst of capacity on Aug 10–24.

Proposed immediate decisions:
- Re-scope the cost-per-token initiative to only include the prefix cache changes for Q3; push quantization v2 to Q4 if we need runway.
- Reserve a small burst pool (2 machines) for pilot phases 1–2; Vanessa to confirm if this can come from current dedicated commit or requires a short-term capacity add.

I've attached: q3_okr_snapshot_v2.xlsx, dependency_matrix.csv. Please reply with stamped decisions or suggested alternatives within 24 hours so I can bake them into the rehearsal notes.

Thanks —
Priyom
Priyom Das
Director, Product Strategy
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle constraint prioritization & launch ramp plan

Priyom —

Thanks for the tidy callout. Short answers and a proposal:

- Resourcing: I can spare 1 PM (me) + 1 SWE (Lina) from the growth backlog for an 8-week window starting Aug 2, provided we shift two lower-priority experiments. Lina will split 50/50 initially (onboarding + pilot automation).
- Capacity: We have ~1.2 machines of burst headroom in our committed pool today; to hit the two-pilot ramp comfortably we should request a temporary 1-machine add for Aug 10–24. I'll talk to CloudPartner (ops-support) and confirm pricing.
- Scope: I support deferring quantization v2. We should lock the prefix cache and batching changes only.

Next steps: I'll attach a short capacity plan and pricing estimate once Ops responds. If leadership signs off, we can freeze the OKR scope and update the dependency matrix.

Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
VP, Customer Growth
Redwood Inference

Attachments: capacity_plan.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2026 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle constraint prioritization & launch ramp plan

Folks —

Technical reality check: we can free up roughly 3 sprint-weeks across the serving runtime team if we postpone the non-blocking perf refactors (the async KV work and the experimental kernel rewrite). That requires pausing two smaller infra spike tickets (INF-1329, INF-1337).

If we go the minimal-scope route (prefix cache + batching):
- Effort estimate: 2 engineers x 3 sprints (primary) + 1 engineer x 1 sprint (QA/instrumentation).
- Risk: latency regressions at high-concurrency pathological cases; mitigation is to enable a guarded canary and hold rollback playbook ready.

I added a short tech note to the tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1342. If Vanessa confirms the 1-machine burst, we can schedule the canary for Aug 12–14.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle constraint prioritization & launch ramp plan

All —

I'll own the QBR artifacts. Deliverables and deadlines:
- 1-slide exec summary (single-sentence ask, top 3 bullets) — Monday 10:00 PT.
- 1-page risk register (top 5 risks, owners, mitigations) — Monday 5:00 PT.
- Deck slide with updated commitments and dependency matrix — Monday 10:00 PT.

Presenter: I'll propose Priyom for the exec readout unless you prefer otherwise.

Note: for the exec slide, please give me a single-line "status" for each OKR (ON_TRACK / AT_RISK / RED) and a one-line mitigation I can paste. Example: Dedicated runtime availability — AT_RISK — Mitigation: freeze non-critical perf work; reserve 1-machine burst for pilot canary.

Attaching the QBR slide template.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of GTM Strategy
Redwood Inference

Attachments: qbr_slide_template.pptx

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle constraint prioritization & launch ramp plan

Thanks — good alignment. Quick summary for the rehearsal notes (action items):

1) Scope: lock to prefix cache + batching. Quantization v2 moved to Q4. (Decision: Priyom)
2) Resources: Vanessa to confirm 1 PM (Vanessa) + 1 SWE (Lina) allocation and confirm CloudPartner pricing by EOD Monday. (Owner: Vanessa)
3) Infra: Karthik to schedule canary Aug 12–14 pending burst confirmation; pause INF-1329 and INF-1337. (Owner: Karthik)
4) QBR: Laura to produce the exec slide + risk register and will present the readout; Priyom will be on the leadership panel for technical Q&A. (Owner: Laura)

I will update the dependency matrix and push the final briefing doc to the drive link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1qbr_exec_summary — please add any final comments there.

If anyone thinks we need an exec sign-off before Monday, flag it now. Otherwise I'll mark this as the working plan and include it in the rehearsal notes.

—Priyom
